recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes the remaining source defects found for FHIR-38873 while preserving the intentional fhir-old-types MedicationUsage compatibility entry.
issue_request: FHIR-38873 was a Published/Persuasive Pharmacy technical correction asking for consistent FHIR resource naming after MedicationUsage was renamed back to MedicationStatement, including capitalization/spelling across affected sections.
initial_application: No repository commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-38873 was found. The underlying rename-back was applied under FHIR-38682 by commits b2032629f28 and fa758a19fa, but current source still had malformed MedicationStatement/MedicationAdministration wording in the MedicationStatement root ElementDefinition and MedicationUsage type values in two CMS146 data-requirements examples.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists MedicationStatement, Library, and Measure, so the edited files are in current core build scope. FHIR-19469 is the earlier rename to MedicationUsage, FHIR-38682 is the later rename back to MedicationStatement, and the remaining old-types CodeSystem entry intentionally records MedicationUsage as a historical resource name. Pharmacy Confluence minutes for 2022-11-14 list FHIR-38873 as 'Will be updated'; exact-key Zulip search found no relevant discussion.
reconciliation: Changed the active MedicationStatement root ElementDefinition to use canonical MedicationStatement and MedicationAdministration names, and changed source/library and source/measure CMS146 data-requirements JSON type values from MedicationUsage to MedicationStatement.
source_changes: source/medicationstatement/structuredefinition-MedicationStatement.xml: normalized malformed medicationstatement/medicationadministration wording in the root ElementDefinition definition to MedicationStatement/MedicationAdministration.
source/library/cms146_data_requirements.json: changed the CMS146 dataRequirement type from MedicationUsage to MedicationStatement.
source/measure/cms146_data_requirements.json: changed the CMS146 dataRequirement type from MedicationUsage to MedicationStatement.
